ranked_facts.why: the new onset 2/6 holosystolic murmur is more likely to be associated with infective endocarditis, as it suggests valve involvement, which is a hallmark of this condition, and less likely to be associated with non-infective endocarditis or other conditions.

ranked_facts.concept_key: past medical history of mitral valve replacement
ranked_facts.why: a past medical history of mitral valve replacement increases the risk of infective endocarditis, as prosthetic valves are more susceptible to infection, and this fact is less likely to be associated with non-infective endocarditis or other conditions.
